intro: Sink into unmatched comfort with the Alantra recliner. Designed with a solid wood frame, durable composite leather, recline-swivel functions, and superior foam filling, it lets you relax, every day.

features.title: Unmatched comfort with premium finish
features.text: The Alantra recliner combines plush leatherette upholstery with key touchpoints like the seat and backrest, offering luxurious softness, durability, and an elegant look.

features.title: Smooth and adjustable reclining mechanism
features.text: The recliner features a smooth manual reclining mechanism that allows you to lounge at any angle up to 140 degrees. It also includes rocking motion for a relaxing experience.

features.title: Superior comfort with high-quality foam and recliner fittings
features.text: Designed for maximum relaxation, the recliner is fitted with soft foam cushioning and premium headrest support to ensure your spine stays well-aligned and comfortable.

features.title: Solid wood frame for lasting durability
features.text: Built from a solid wood frame with a moisture content of 12%, the recliner guarantees structural reliability and strength for years of dependable use.

features.title: Exceptional craftsmanship with precise stitching and fit
features.text: The Alantra recliner’s superior design and flawless stitching give it a polished appearance, making it a standout piece that adds elegance to any modern living space.

name: Alantra 1-Seater Leatherette Recliner
